data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts a reduction relation (interventionist criterion in SRC_003 and SRC_001 'reduces to' a special case of frame dependence), but the refutation condition demands an intervention whose outcome is invariant across all epistemic frames — an infinitely strong, unfalsifiable standard requiring exhaustion of all possible model expansions. This refutation condition does not test the reduction: exhibiting one frame-invariant intervention would not show that the interventionist criterion fails to reduce to frame dependence, since a single invariant case could be an exception that proves the general reduction. The condition is orthogonal to whether the reduction holds; it tests a metaphysical property of one intervention rather than testing whether the reduction relation is genuine.
